onset.Description: Onset of the event in seconds from recording start

duration.Description: Duration of the event in seconds

sample.Description: Onset of the event in samples

value.Description: Numeric value of the marker as recorded by Emotiv EmotivPRO

type.Description: Event marker type recorded via Emotiv EmotivPRO

marker_value.Description: Numeric value of the marker as assigned in EmotivPRO

key.Description: Keystroke or port source of the marker

timestamp.Description: Absolute datetime timestamp of the event in ISO 8601 format

marker_id.Description: Sequential index of the marker within the recording session
